peopleAlsoAsk.question: Is a board game cafe profitable?

peopleAlsoAsk.answer: A board game café is a type of café in which patrons play board and card games while being served food and drink. Customers usually pay an entry fee or rent a table in order to access a large library of games and instruction from the staff on how to play them. Many board game cafés also sell the games.
